messages:
mari: quick sync — we're about to land a change that makes header-based routing use a precedence matrix instead of the current ad-hoc fallbacks. need policy + telemetry decisions before the console rollout.
kevin: +1. can you sketch the matrix? thinking priority: x-route-override > x-auth-assertion > x-client-meta > user-agent.
sam: that ordering seems reasonable, but user-agent is used by a few legacy clients for tenant sharding. we should add an explicit opt-in flag for legacy UA behavior to avoid surprises.
mari: yep. proposal: default to new matrix; add a per-tenant feature flag `enable_legacy_ua_sharding` that keeps old UA precedence. do we want a global console toggle too?
tala: console toggle makes sense for staged rollout. also, we should emit telemetry whenever routing decision used a non-default header (so we can detect regressions). e.g. emit `routing.header_chosen` with tag header_name, tenant_id, route_id.
kevin: agree on telemetry. add counts for fallbacks too. we'll need low-cardinality labels only — header_name, decision_type (matched/failed/fallback). avoid sending raw UA strings.
mari: good call on PII avoidance. for the console UX: we should show a per-route column that indicates which header was authoritative in the last 24h and a small spike chart. will be useful for support.
sam: for rollout plan: canary on 10% of traffic for 24h, with automatic rollback if error-rate increases by >3x or latency +95p jumps >50ms. also run compatibility job that replays production requests through the new matcher and reports differences.
tala: can we get that replay job to also surface tenants that rely on UA sharding? would help populate the feature-flag opt-ins.
platform-bot: replay-job scheduled: job_id=reroute-replay-171512, eta=2h. results will be uploaded to /internal/reroute-replays/171512.
mari: config snippet I'm proposing for the gateway (basic):
```yaml
routing:
  precedence:
    - x-route-override
    - x-auth-assertion
    - x-client-meta
    - user-agent
  feature_flags:
    enable_legacy_ua_sharding: false
  telemetry:
    emit_header_metrics: true
```
kevin: looks good. one more guard: if x-auth-assertion is present but signature invalid, we should ignore it and record a `routing.header_invalid` metric, not fall back silently.
sam: agreed — surface invalid assertions in the console as a warning on the route page.
mari: action items: 1) kevin to add validation + metric for invalid assertions (PR). 2) sam to run reroute replay and collect UA-shard candidates. 3) tala to add telemetry schema and console column mock. 4) I'll draft the canary plan and rollout doc. aim to start canary on Mon.
tala: I'll mock the console column and add a tiny filter to hide exact UA strings (hash them).
kevin: coding now, will open PR in ~3h. tagging @sam for any edgecases you want the replay to include. :thumbsup:
sam: thanks — will add tenant sampling + request header dump to the replay job.
mari: awesome. no blockers otherwise. we can announce the canary in #eng-releases tomorrow.
platform-bot: deploy-check: canary-policy present? no — blocking until rollout doc uploaded at /docs/routing-rollout-171512.md
mari: noted — adding doc to that path now.
kevin: PR opened: github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4821 — includes validation + metrics.
platform-bot: reroute-replay job completed: job_id=reroute-replay-171512, diff_count=43, tenants_with_ua_shard_hint=7, report=/internal/reroute-replays/171512/report.json
sam: loading report now. initial glance: 5 of those tenants will definitely need the feature flag. I'll start outreach.
mari: perfect, thanks everyone. we'll sync after the canary results. :party:
